latestVersion.changelog:
Video Background Skill — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video background removal and replacement for content creators, remote workers, and marketers.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; renders 1080p MP4 videos in 30–60 seconds via cloud GPU.
- No green screen required; steady camera shots yield best results.
- Simple workflow: upload video, describe desired background/result, receive processed video for download.
- Integrates cloud session management, flexible credit/token system, and robust error handling.
- Covers common tasks: background replacement, timeline edits, preview, export, and batch processing.
